candidate_findings.title: Broad pre-run cleanup has no artifact-ownership barrier
candidate_findings.gap: The plan permits `git clean` over all untracked and optionally ignored content, including in the main repository, but does not distinguish prior-run cruft from legitimate user work, crash-recovery output, or another actor's newly created files.
candidate_findings.why_it_matters: An irreversible pre-run clean can silently destroy uncommitted work before an agent starts, especially when a run uses the main repository or aggressive ignored-file cleanup.
candidate_findings.missing_contract: Require a validated execution-owned root, a provenance manifest for deletable artifacts, a dry-run inventory, explicit authorization for main-repository or `-x` cleanup, and quarantine or recovery semantics before deletion.

candidate_findings.missing_contract: Make execution ownership and worktree identity mandatory inputs, resolve and verify `owner_thread_id` before any deletion, and reject runner cleanup for assistant-owned worktrees independently of caller behavior.

candidate_findings.missing_contract: Require a pre-stage and pre-commit gate that checks owned paths and content, rejects sensitive material regardless of ignore status, prevents logging the rejected content, and records only redacted failure evidence.
